opportunities.title: Cara's Fellowship Programme
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to direct applications from individual academics at risk in their home country or recently displaced, regardless of nationality, who are being forced to flee by the risk of imminent imprisonment, injury or death. Some need postgraduate qualifications (e.g. PhD); others hold doctorates and seek postdoctoral placements.
opportunities.summary: Rescue programme that places academics at risk of imminent imprisonment, injury or death into temporary refuge at universities and research institutions (mostly in the UK, sometimes elsewhere). It helps secure 2- or 3-year fellowship placements, including PhD or postdoctoral placements, negotiates the placement, allocates additional funding, and assists with visas and practical arrangements for the academic and accompanying family. Applications are considered on a rolling basis.
